# Privacy by design 0.1.0

The design-facing part of privacy, applied to any design that holds personal information (a data set with personal true brings the personal-data profile in). It asks whether the design knows what personal data it holds, why, where, for how long and who can reach it, whether it can honour the rights of the people the data is about, and whether the privacy impact assessment has been handed over. It does not replace that assessment, a data protection impact assessment or a privacy officer's judgement: it reads their outcome (standard, section 9), and checks that the design gives them something to assess.

Applies to designs with the `personal-data` profile. Source: [`standards/assessment/lenses/privacy.yaml`](../../standards/assessment/lenses/privacy.yaml).

## DAT: Personal data

Does the design say what personal data it holds, where, for how long and from where?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PRV-DAT-01](prv-dat-01.md) | Does every personal data set state where it is kept, how long it is kept and where it comes from? | major | tool |

## MIN: Purpose and minimisation

Is every personal data set needed for a stated purpose, and no more of it than the purpose needs?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PRV-MIN-01](prv-min-01.md) | Is every personal data set needed for a goal the design states, and does the design hold no more of it, and for no longer, than that goal needs? | major | reviewer |

## SEC: Protection

Is personal data classified for what it is, and reachable only by callers who are authenticated and authorised?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PRV-SEC-01](prv-sec-01.md) | Is every personal data set classified confidential or restricted? | minor | tool |
| [PRV-SEC-02](prv-sec-02.md) | Does every connector that carries personal data authenticate the caller and authorise the call? | major | tool |

## RGT: Rights of the people the data is about

Can the design find, correct, export and erase one person's data?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PRV-RGT-01](prv-rgt-01.md) | Does a scenario show how one person's data is found, exported, corrected or erased, across every store that holds it? | major | both |

## AI: Personal data and models

Where a model learns from or remembers personal data, is that lawful and reversible?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PRV-AI-01](prv-ai-01.md) | Where personal data trains, fine-tunes or is remembered by a model, is the lawful basis recorded, and can one person's data be taken out again? | blocker | reviewer |

## IMP: Impact and risk

Is the privacy impact assessed, and are the privacy risks owned?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PRV-IMP-01](prv-imp-01.md) | Is the privacy impact assessment, or the data protection impact assessment, handed over and cited as evidence? | major | tool |
| [PRV-IMP-02](prv-imp-02.md) | Is at least one risk to the people the data is about recorded, with an owner? | major | both |
